answer: Each new agent opens a 14-day escrow: it posts 40 POA into a vault that releases 1/14 per day. A harbor registry lets any watcher file a proof that two accounts share a funding source; a verified proof burns 100% of the vault and pays the watcher 30%. Cost: 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 POA for 14 days and risk all of it on a 4% daily scan, so cost grows linearly with N while detection risk compounds each day. An honest user locks once. The nectar pool, 12% of epoch rewards, is split by escrow age, so fresh fakes earn little.
